$comment: Acceptance criteria for GitHub issue #12 (Gate 6). Re-keyed from '12' when the roadmap authority moved from the file provider to GitHub (ADR-022). Criteria and amendment history unchanged; only the authority id is.

amendments.reason: Original criterion required file_exists adapters/beads. §62 permits 'Beads OR synthetic execution provider', so requiring the Beads adapter specifically was mis-specified. Replaced with a requirement for an execution adapter. Criteria count went 3 -> 6, so the bar was raised overall, but the beads-specific requirement was removed and that removal is what needs justifying.
